scope: formal is_active candidate whitelist vs current question library
purpose: 判断候选映射是否仍可能被动态题库读取；只读
query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.question_key) AS candidate_keys,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.question_key IS NOT NULL THEN q.question_key END) AS active_library_keys,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.question_key IS NULL THEN q.question_key END) AS missing_library_keys,
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) AS candidate_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.question_key IS NOT NULL THEN q.id END) AS active_library_rows
FROM question_option_mapping_v5_real q
LEFT JOIN question_library_v5_real l
  ON l.question_key COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci = q.question_key COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
 AND l.data_status IN ('audited','partial')
 AND l.review_status IN ('audited','partial')
WHERE q.cms_lifecycle='legacy_compat'
  AND q.is_active=1
  AND q.data_status='audited'
  AND q.review_status='audited'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM outcome_route_questions r
    WHERE r.question_key COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci = q.question_key COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
      AND r.enabled=1 AND r.data_status='active' AND r.review_status='audited'
  )
decision: 不能把候选集合视为零影响停用集合；当前动态仓储按question_key读取审核映射，存在题库键即可形成潜在消费路径
